provenance.selection_rule: Include only index/counting/arithmetic semantics that remain non-Core after the graph-derived Core-definability audit.

governing_authority.qu: not used unless a genuine unresolved semantic family appears

items.body: There is an inductive natural-index carrier N with distinguished zero value 0 and successor constructor S:N->N; zero is not a successor and successor is injective.

N carries induction/well-founded recursion authority: a property holding at zero and preserved from n to S(n) holds for every n in N, and recursive definitions over N must expose zero and successor clauses.
Natural addition add:NxN->N is defined by add(a,0)=a and add(a,S(b))=S(add(a,b)).
Natural multiplication mul:NxN->N is defined by mul(a,0)=0 and mul(a,S(b))=add(mul(a,b),a).
Natural strict order lt(a,b) holds exactly when there exists a nonzero successor-count k such that add(a,k)=b; weak order le(a,b) holds exactly when a=b or lt(a,b).
For every n in N there is a finite index segment I(n) whose members are exactly the natural indices k satisfying lt(k,n).
A carrier X has exact finite cardinality n exactly when there exists a bijective typed map between I(n) and X.

Signed integers are represented by an exact quotient of ordered natural pairs (a,b), where (a,b) and (c,d) are equivalent exactly when add(a,d)=add(c,b); integer addition and multiplication are induced from natural addition and multiplication and must be well-defined under the quotient.

Rationals are represented by an exact quotient of integer/natural pairs (p,q) with q nonzero, where (p,q) and (r,s) are equivalent exactly when p*s=r*q; rational addition and multiplication are induced by the usual cross-product formulas and must be well-defined under the quotient.

Natural, integer, and rational exact literals used by downstream schemas are represented through canonical embeddings N->Z->Q and equality in the target carrier; a printed numeral or fraction alone carries no arithmetic behavior.
For every n and carrier A, an n-tuple over A is an indexed family t with domain I(n) and values in A; tuple equality is extensional equality at every index in I(n).

Given a carrier A, binary operation op:AxA->A, identity e in A, n in N, and tuple t:I(n)->A, fold(op,e,t) is defined by the zero case e and successor case applying op to the preceding fold and the next indexed value; the schema records operand order explicitly.

anti_scope: No field/group/vector/matrix/bundle/projective/topological/differential/physical object is part of DNIA source semantics.
No Woit or Lisi source object is a premise.
DNIA may not be used by W or L until independent qualification completes.
Historical primitive-natural-arithmetic artifacts are evidence only and were not used to choose this frozen SSC.
required_pipeline: recursive implicit assertions to fixed point
NEI/DTS only if their semantics are actually invoked
